raw_response: {"diagnosis":"85 EUR rows in raw_transactions are summed as if they were USD because silver_transactions ignores the currency column. raw_fx_rates has a single EUR rate (1.25 to USD), so silver can convert amounts to USD before the gold aggregations.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
